content_en: The first version delivered to the quality control team has poor performance, and the testers are complaining that they cannot complete all the test cases as planned. Which is a tool to help to monitor performance?
option_1_content_en: A.Run Chart
option_2_content_en: B.Data Flow Diagram
option_3_content_en: C.Flow Chart
option_4_content_en: D.Non-Control Chart

content_en: A project manager for a small company is assigned to a project with a scope that is complex and new. The program manager recommends creating a team with individuals that can offer complementary expertise. What are the characteristics of the network that should be built?
option_1_content_en: A.Central coordination, team members with internal and external stakeholders, all participants abiding to the work agreement and set of rules
option_2_content_en: B.Self-organized, team members with internal and external stakeholders, all participants abiding to the work agreement and set of rules
option_3_content_en: C.Self-organized, team members with internal stakeholders, all participants abiding to the work agreement and set of rules
option_4_content_en: D.Central coordination, team members with internal stakeholders, all participants abiding to the work agreement and set of rules

content_en: In the middle of project execution, the project sponsor leaves, and a new sponsor is assigned. The new sponsor is requesting major revisions to the deliverables. What should the project manager do?
option_1_content_en: A.Implement all the changes to the deliverables.
option_2_content_en: B.Request additional resources to adjust the deliverables.
option_3_content_en: C.Evaluate the possible impacts of the changes.
option_4_content_en: D.Extend the project timeline to include the changes.

content_en: A new Scrum project manager at a company is contracted to build a traffic measurement and control application for a municipality. The project manager is notified that the municipality has just rejected the traffic measurement portion of the application because it does not comply with longstanding national regulations. What should the project manager have done to avoid this situation?
option_1_content_en: A.Requested that the product owner handle the regulation compliance.
option_2_content_en: B.Allocated an experienced team member to validate regulatory compliance.
option_3_content_en: C.Made the scrum master solely responsible for regulatory compliance.
option_4_content_en: D.Discussed the importance of regulation compliance with the sponsor.

content_en: A company has decided to form agile teams within the organization to improve project results and take advantage of new opportunities in the market. A project manager with extensive agile experience was recruited to oversee the process. What should the project manager do first?
option_1_content_en: A.Recruit, appoint, and evaluate new agile project practitioners.
option_2_content_en: B.Implement an agile project management office (PMO).
option_3_content_en: C.Determine the criteria for when to launch agile projects.
option_4_content_en: D.Perform a retrospective analysis of prior project experiences.

content_en: A large-scale, multiyear transformation project was completed as per the defined requirements and within the approved budget and schedule. The requirements were also validated and confirmed by the business. However, the post-delivery analysis of the project revealed that the project did not provide benefits as expected. What should the project manager have done to avoid this?
option_1_content_en: A.Ensured the requirements were properly captured in the product backlog.
option_2_content_en: B.Created a business strategy to assist with organizational change management.
option_3_content_en: C.Improved the status reporting processes to highlight specific project results.
option_4_content_en: D.Measured and demonstrated business value throughout the project lifecycle.

content_en: A project manager is managing a hybrid project with a fixed time and fixed price agreement. The project manager is having difficulty getting the team to submit their time sheets. The feedback received from the team is that work will be delivered every two weeks, so no time sheets are required. However, the project manager needs the time sheets to complete a cost assessment of the project. What should the project manager do to ensure all team members submit their time sheets as required?
option_1_content_en: A.Ask the project management office (PMO) to ensure the team submits their time sheets.
option_2_content_en: B.Send a weekly reminder to each team member notifying them to submit their time sheets.
option_3_content_en: C.Explain the impact of not submitting time sheets on the project's cost assessment.
option_4_content_en: D.Change the submission frequency for the time sheets from biweekly to weekly.

content_en: A department store chain is in the implementation stage of a project to replace the payment systems across all of its stores in multiple countries. The project planning followed a predictive approach, and implementation is based on multiple iterations for each country. Implementation in country C is stalled due to new laws regulating the security of the new payment solution implementation. Which two actions should the project manager take to avoid a significant delay on the project? (Choose two)
option_1_content_en: A.Monitor compliance with the laws of each country continuously during planning and after implementation in each country.
option_2_content_en: B.Document the legal compliance risks in the project management plan for country C in the implementation phase and iterations.
option_3_content_en: C.Deploy alternative systems compatible with the security standards and legal framework for country C.
option_4_content_en: D.Execute another country's implementation phase after validating the compliance standards while a solution is prepared for country C.
option_5_content_en: E.Communicate the delay in the project to the steering committee, and place the project on hold until a decision is reached.

content_en: An organization previously using predictive approaches has recently decided to adopt the Scaled Agile Framework (SAFe®) approach. A critical project for the organization is in the middle of the execution phase at the time of this decision. Which approach should the project manager use to continue the project delivery?
option_1_content_en: A.Scrum
option_2_content_en: B.Kanban
option_3_content_en: C.Predictive
option_4_content_en: D.Large-Scale Scrum (LeSS)

content_en: A project manager is leading a project that requires approval from a government agency. The agency is currently drafting legislation that will impact the project's approval process, but it is unclear when the legislation will become law. The project manager is concerned that the legislation may delay the project's key milestones or limit the project's development options. What should the project manager do?
option_1_content_en: A.Apply for an additional contingency to prepare for the anticipated delay in project milestones.
option_2_content_en: B.Review the project scope and submit a request to exclude activities associated with the legislation.
option_3_content_en: C.Continuously evaluate exposure to the risk to minimize negative impacts on the project and its outcomes.
option_4_content_en: D.Proceed with the project with the understanding that the pending legislation will pass without delay.

content_en: A project manager is leading a critical project to deliver a new solution. The CEO is highly invested in the project, and the CFO is the product owner. During the testing phase, the CFO requests an additional nonfunctional requirement to shorten the frequency of transaction processing. This new requirement will impact the launch date, and the CFO is insistent on having it implemented. What should the project manager do to minimize the impact of the new requirement on the launch date and manage the expectations of the CEO and CFO?
option_1_content_en: A.Meet with the CFO and suggest delaying the implementation of the new requirement to the post-launch phase.
option_2_content_en: B.Ask the CEO to intervene and stop the implementation of the new requirement, as development is complete.
option_3_content_en: C.Tell the project team to update the product backlog with the new requirement and adjust the project plans.
option_4_content_en: D.Assess the scope of the new nonfunctional requirement to determine its specific impact on the planned go-live date.

content_en: A project manager is working on a hybrid (predictive-agile) project. During a standup meeting, a team member mentions that because of experience on a previous project, they think that one of the upcoming deliverables may need to comply with government regulations. What should the project manager do next?
option_1_content_en: A.Escalate the issue with the project management office (PMO) so they can determine if any compliance is required.
option_2_content_en: B.Stop the project until it is confirmed that the deliverable is subject to any regulations.
option_3_content_en: C.Review lessons learned from the previous project to determine if any compliance is required.
option_4_content_en: D.Remove the task from the critical path and assign the resource to work on another requirement.

content_en: A project for an accounts receivable system that was recently launched into production received a fine from a regulatory body because the system did not comply with local regulations. What should the project manager have done to avoid this situation?
option_1_content_en: A.Defined risk control management.
option_2_content_en: B.Defined a control quality process.
option_3_content_en: C.Implemented an issue control log.
option_4_content_en: D.Involved the audit department in project planning.

content_en: A project manager is assigned to a legacy system modernization project. The project management plan is solidified and the requirements have been handed off to the IT department for development. However, the company's CEO announces the company's new strategic direction and upcoming plans for an enterprise resource planning (ERP) implementation. What should the project manager do?
option_1_content_en: A.Ask the project sponsor for recommendations to keep the project on track.
option_2_content_en: B.Understand and clarify how the existing project aligns with the overall organization vision.
option_3_content_en: C.Conduct a project team meeting to plan and confirm resource assignments for the new project.
option_4_content_en: D.Review the project schedule to ensure the project will be completed on time.

content_en: A business environment has become unstable because a stakeholder has altered the project deliverables and outcomes in the middle of the execution phase. Taking the stakeholder into consideration, how should the project manager ensure the project benefits are delivered?
option_1_content_en: A.Ensure the project team agrees to the project management plan and provide the stakeholder with constant updates.
option_2_content_en: B.Combine both agile and predictive approaches and manage changes to the overall scope with minimal deviations.
option_3_content_en: C.Ensure the project's deliverables and objectives are tailored to the initial requirements.
option_4_content_en: D.Engage the stakeholder based on level of impact and ensure their requirements are captured adequately according to change management process.

content_en: During a project governance assessment, and after expending 40% of the approved project budget, management approved the auditor's recommendation to have the project terminated. What should the project manager do next?
option_1_content_en: A.Compute the expected monetary value of the project and document it in lessons learned.
option_2_content_en: B.Engage an independent consultant to justify project continuation.
option_3_content_en: C.Initiate the project closeout process and document lessons learned for future reference.
option_4_content_en: D.Prepare a financial report to recognize the actual costs expended as sunk costs.

content_en: A project team is working on a regulatory application that has a fixed duration for delivery. The team is using a hybrid approach and has divided development into three sprints. The first two sprints have not produced the required results mainly due to delays from functional units. The finance director is agitated due to the imminent sanctions if the application is not completed, and the project team is demoralized. Who is responsible for inspiring the project team?
option_1_content_en: A.Product Owner
option_2_content_en: B.Financial Director
option_3_content_en: C.Functional Manager
option_4_content_en: D.Project Manager

content_en: A client requests a major scope change due to a change in the market environment, which will significantly add to the project cost. This change is approved through the change control process. What should the project manager do to put the project on track?
option_1_content_en: A.Reevaluate the scope baseline and impact on the project objectives.
option_2_content_en: B.Use the management reserve to account for the schedule uncertainty.
option_3_content_en: C.Monitor risks to ensure the effectiveness of the risk management process.
option_4_content_en: D.Reevaluate the cost management plan to address the impact of the change.

content_en: A project manager is leading a project that received a request for additional scope caused by changes in market demand. The change request also seeks a more rapid delivery time frame. Which two actions should the project manager take? (Choose two)
option_1_content_en: A.Assess company performance and the scope of other projects to ensure minimal impact.
option_2_content_en: B.Organize a workshop with the sponsors and ask them to increase the project budget.
option_3_content_en: C.Collect data and analyze the business environment to validate the business benefits.
option_4_content_en: D.Assess new technologies and competitors, then benchmark the change against them.
option_5_content_en: E.Organize a risk workshop, then update the risk management plan and the risk register.

content_en: Due to a downturn in the business environment, a customer is only able to make a project's payment in part, rather than the fully committed monthly payment. What should the project manager do?
option_1_content_en: A.Discuss it with management and pause the project because of the customer's budget constraint.
option_2_content_en: B.Deliver the features with the highest business value, based on the available budget.
option_3_content_en: C.Deliver the features that have small independent components, based on the available budget.
option_4_content_en: D.Continue with the planned development and deliver only when full payment is made.

content_en: A project manager new to an organization has been tasked with running the first agile project. The project manager has decided to begin by assessing the organization's ability to adapt to an agile project. Which three characteristics of the organization will help to set up the project for success? (Choose three)
option_1_content_en: A.Safe work environment
option_2_content_en: B.Key performance indicators (KPIs)
option_3_content_en: C.Willingness to experiment
option_4_content_en: D.Speed to market

content_en: A project manager is tracking an infrastructure project that is dependent on a service provider. The service provider informed the project manager that some of the third-party components will no longer be manufactured or supported. Upon an initial review, this would significantly delay the schedule and increase the budget. What should the project manager do?
option_1_content_en: A.Escalate this issue to the project sponsor.
option_2_content_en: B.Update the risk register.
option_3_content_en: C.Convene a review with the team.
option_4_content_en: D.Update the project status to reflect these findings.

content_en: A project is under scrutiny for its amount of water usage. The government's water licensing branch is changing its policy to be more restrictive. What should the project manager do?
option_1_content_en: A.Align project resources to oppose the new water license standard.
option_2_content_en: B.Cancel the project because of the uncertainty introduced with the policy change.
option_3_content_en: C.Assess the impact of the policy change on the project scope.
option_4_content_en: D.Create a new project schedule based on potential changes to the water policy.

content_en: Following the start of a sprint, a key stakeholder constructed an email to a project team voicing displeasure of the work that just commenced, despite being inexperienced in agile. The stakeholder is insistent about changing the internal and external deliverables. What next step should the project manager take?
option_1_content_en: A.Request the team’s assessment of the matter at the next standup meeting.
option_2_content_en: B.Change the backlog and comply with the stakeholder’s request.
option_3_content_en: C.Facilitate a meeting with the product owner and the key stakeholder to align on deliverables.
option_4_content_en: D.Encourage the stakeholder to participate in a discussion regarding backlog clarification.

content_en:
A new project manager is assigned to lead an agile project. The project manager wants to use motivation to encourage the team to perform well throughout the project.

What should the project manager do?
option_1_content_en: A.Implement a reward system aimed to keep the team engaged and motivated.
option_2_content_en: B.Use the management reserves to fund some team-building activities.
option_3_content_en: C.Inflate project estimates to provide a financial buffer for team activities.
option_4_content_en: D.Ask project sponsor to fund more for team building activities.

content_en: A company begins to implement Scrum. About halfway through the first sprint, communication issues develop. Some project team members are not in sync with other team members. What should the project manager do next?
option_1_content_en: A.Educate the team on the importance of communication in Scrum.
option_2_content_en: B.Establish clear communication guidelines.
option_3_content_en: C.Identify the root cause of the communication issues.
option_4_content_en: D.Monitor the team's communication and provide feedback.

content_en: A team is assembled for a new project that will be using a predictive approach through requirements gathering and an agile approach for development and testing. Not everyone on the team has experience working in agile. The schedule has started slipping due to the unclear structure of the agile development approach. What should the project manager have done to avoid this situation?
option_1_content_en: A.Set up weekly status meetings to review team progress and regularly escalate delays.
option_2_content_en: B.Met with the team, allowed team members to make decisions about what to do, and established performance goals.
option_3_content_en: C.Established daily standup meetings to track team progress and escalate delays to stakeholders as appropriate.
option_4_content_en: D.Conducted routine meetings and identified team members who are under performing.

content_en: A project manager is assigned to a water treatment investment project. The local government has recently passed a law that requires compliance with clean water according to global standards. This is a new regulation that was initiated in the last month and was quickly passed. What should the project manager do?
option_1_content_en: A.Inform the stakeholders and continue with the project according to the original plans since the law was passed after the project started.
option_2_content_en: B.Meet with the project sponsor and recommend that the project continue because the new legal requirements can be delivered.
option_3_content_en: C.Conduct an analysis of the impact of the regulation on the project and the business and communicate it to stakeholders.
option_4_content_en: D.Recommend that all work on the project be stopped immediately until the impact of the regulation is understood.

content_en: A project manager works in a matrix organization and manages an internal software development project to improve the company's tracking system. The project is scheduled to be completed in one month. Some benefits will be realized once the system is online, however, full benefits will not be realized for a while. Although the project manager will track benefits through project closure, they are concerned about tracking the benefits of post-project activities. What should the project manager do?
option_1_content_en: A.Request that a new project be initiated to monitor and report the achievement of benefits.
option_2_content_en: B.Revise the benefits management plan to extend the project until all benefits are realized.
option_3_content_en: C.Update the work breakdown structure (WBS) and project schedule with tasks to track benefits realization.
option_4_content_en: D.Coordinate with the benefits owner to monitor the achievement of benefits after the project closes.

content_en: A project is developing a product where the time to market is critical. During the execution phase, the client submits a change request to include the latest technology that will enhance the product features and provide a competitive advantage. The change will impact the project constraints, but the benefits outweigh the cost and effort. What should the project manager do next?
option_1_content_en: A.Adopt an incremental delivery approach and release essential features of the product into the market first to counter competition.
option_2_content_en: B.Start a separate project to adopt the new technology incrementally to enhance the product features as the technology matures.
option_3_content_en: C.Perform an integrated change control process and review the project constraints to effectively manage the enhanced scope.
option_4_content_en: D.Close the current project and start a new project with an incremental delivery approach.

content_en: A complex project has multiple participants. The project manager agrees with the team that they need to better understand the perspective of all project participants for the optimal success of the project. What should the project manager do?
option_1_content_en: A.Review the stakeholder analysis.
option_2_content_en: B.Create a communication plan.
option_3_content_en: C.Conduct a SWOT analysis.
option_4_content_en: D.Perform a risk analysis.

content_en: A project execution phase overlaps with a holiday in the country where the majority of team members are based. This phase is critical, and all team members are required to work through the holiday. This negatively impacts team morale. What should the project manager have done to avoid this?
option_1_content_en: A.Requested help from other teams based in other countries
option_2_content_en: B.Postponed project activities
option_3_content_en: C.Prepared the stakeholder engagement plan
option_4_content_en: D.Better developed the resource management plan

content_en: Midway through project execution, several stakeholders raise concerns about team performance and delivery. The project manager believes the project is progressing per the approved scope, budget, and schedule. What should the project manager do next?
option_1_content_en: A.Email the stakeholders to assure them of action.
option_2_content_en: B.Consult the communications management plan to manage stakeholders' expectations.
option_3_content_en: C.Ask the project sponsor to intervene.
option_4_content_en: D.Ask stakeholders to escalate their concerns to the CEO.

content_en: An unforeseen issue results in the need to procure a new piece of machinery critical for meeting quality specifications. From where may the necessary funds be obtained?
option_1_content_en: A.Key stakeholders
option_2_content_en: B.Management reserve
option_3_content_en: C.Contingency reserve
option_4_content_en: D.Project sponsor

content_en: A project manager for a US$15 million construction project must meet a specific project milestone earlier than planned because a season-long pattern of extreme weather is expected soon. The project is already over budget, and the project sponsor is not prepared to provide additional funding. Which tool or technique should the project manager use to achieve the milestone before the extreme weather begins?
option_1_content_en: A.Simulation
option_2_content_en: B.Fast tracking
option_3_content_en: C.Resource smoothing
option_4_content_en: D.Crashing

content_en: A project team completes the identification of project and product requirements. Which of the following were used to accomplish this?
option_1_content_en: A.Benchmarking, network diagram, and trend analysis
option_2_content_en: B.Work breakdown structure (WBS), trend analysis, and observation/conversation
option_3_content_en: C.Brainstorming, affinity diagrams, and mind mapping
option_4_content_en: D.Affinity diagrams, benchmarking, and observation/conversation

content_en: During testing of a project component, a senior tester discovers a functionality that will ensure the future performance of the project's solution. This will create a change in scope. During testing of a project component, a senior tester discovers a functionality that will ensure the future performance of the project's solution. This will create a change in scope. Which type of change request should be made to include this functionality?
option_1_content_en: A.Preventive action
option_2_content_en: B.Corrective action
option_3_content_en: C.Defect repair
option_4_content_en: D.Scope update

content_en: Due to commitments to another project, an accountant fails to deliver an important report to a project manager on time. The project manager did not expect the delay and didn't realize the accountant had conflicting priorities. What should the project manager have done to avoid this?
option_1_content_en: A.Referenced the RACI matrix.
option_2_content_en: B.Referenced timesheets.
option_3_content_en: C.Referenced the resource allocation plan.
option_4_content_en: D.Referenced the resource calendar.

content_en: What should a project manager do to obtain stakeholder agreement?
option_1_content_en: A.Update Resource Management Plan
option_2_content_en: B.Manage Stakeholder Engagement
option_3_content_en: C.Monitor and Control Project Work
option_4_content_en: D.Schedule a meeting between sponsor and stakeholders

content_en: A project manager takes over a recently approved project. What will play a key role in determining the communication method?
option_1_content_en: A.Stakeholder requirements
option_2_content_en: B.Frequency of distribution
option_3_content_en: C.Sender-receiver model
option_4_content_en: D.Meeting management methods

content_en: While reviewing a status report, a project manager notices that, over a period of six months, the coding quality for one developer is statistically lower than another developer assigned the same task. Which tool should the project manager use to trace the problem's source back to its actionable root cause?
option_1_content_en: A.Histogram
option_2_content_en: B.Control chart
option_3_content_en: C.Scatter diagram
option_4_content_en: D.Ishikawa diagram

content_en: While performing a qualitative project risk analysis process the project manager finds that the product is missing the "Definition of Done". What type of risk is this?
option_1_content_en: A.Commercial risk
option_2_content_en: B.External Risk
option_3_content_en: C.Management Risk
option_4_content_en: D.Technical Risk

content_en: During a feedback meeting, the project manager is informed by team members that validating deliverables is difficult due to the fact that technology requirements keep changing before the due dates of their handover causing rework. The project manager suggests a more appropriate project management methodology to be adopted to address this occurrence for upcoming projects. Which project management methodology will work for this team?
option_1_content_en: A.Agile
option_2_content_en: B.Predictive
option_3_content_en: C.Waterfall
option_4_content_en: D.Incremental

content_en: There is a conflict between two team members regarding a project task. Which conflict resolution method should project manager use to make it win-win situation?
option_1_content_en: A.Collaborate/problem solve
option_2_content_en: B.Force/direct
option_3_content_en: C.Smooth/accommodate
option_4_content_en: D.Compromise/reconcile

content_en: A project manager is not able to complete the list of project objectives due to conflicting directives from two department directors. Which approach would allow the directors to adjust their directives with a win/win outcome?
option_1_content_en: A.Collaborate/problem solve
option_2_content_en: B.Withdraw/avoid
option_3_content_en: C.Smooth/accommodate
option_4_content_en: D.Force/direct

content_en: A project leader noticed that a new team member is demotivated and always arrives late to work, causing a delay in the deliverables. What should the project manager do?
option_1_content_en: A.Ask HR to deal with the team member's attendance, advise them to arrive on time, and remind them of the incentives at the end of the project.
option_2_content_en: B.Ask a senior team member to speak with the team member, share personal experiences, and find out the reasons for the performance issues.
option_3_content_en: C.During the daily meeting, ask all team members to arrive on time, and plan an event after working hours to celebrate the project progress.
option_4_content_en: D.Talk with the team member on a one-to-one basis, emphasizing the importance of teamwork and the value of each member's contributions.

content_en:
A project manager complains that three engineers from different cultural backgrounds leave project meetings twice a day and assumes that they are "gossiping and smoking" for 15 minutes. The engineering manager replies that their absence is due to prayer time.

What should the project manager do first to rectify their assumption?
option_1_content_en: A.Apologize for the unconscious bias.
option_2_content_en: B.Develop a plan to improve work ethic.
option_3_content_en: C.Set up a meeting to raise cultural awareness.
option_4_content_en: D.Follow and watch to make an informed observation.

content_en:
In a project, there is a stakeholder who does not see any benefit for the project. Sometimes the stakeholder uses politics to place obstacles to prevent a successful project completion.

What is the personality of this kind of stakeholder?
option_1_content_en: A.Stoic
option_2_content_en: B.Neutral
option_3_content_en: C.Champion
option_4_content_en: D.Antagonist

content_en: A key stakeholder's input is essential to a project's success. However, the stakeholder is always late on critical project decisions. What can the project manager do to re-engage this stakeholder?
option_1_content_en: A.Meet with the stakeholder to understand the reason for the delay.
option_2_content_en: B.Remove the stakeholder from the project.
option_3_content_en: C.Brief the steering committee on the stakeholder's delays.
option_4_content_en: D.Add the stakeholder's delay to the issue log.

content_en: A project manager must ensure stakeholder responsibilities are clear, concise, and promote successful completion while maintaining stakeholder engagement. What should the project manager do?
option_1_content_en: A.Collaborate with the stakeholder to define their manageable workload.
option_2_content_en: B.Assign new responsibilities only after prior deadlines have been met.
option_3_content_en: C.Assign as many responsibilities as they believe the stakeholder can handle.
option_4_content_en: D.Add at least two new responsibilities after prior deadlines are met.

content_en: A project manager working in a global organization decides to use a low-cost social media platform to exchange information, knowledge, and experience within the organization. Which three challenges should the project manager be prepared to deal with? (Choose three)
option_1_content_en: A.Lack of physical interaction
option_2_content_en: B.Time differences
option_3_content_en: C.Competing priorities
option_4_content_en: D.Lack of funding

content_en: An agile project team is implementing a supporting technology platform across departments. They're planning a readiness review for the delivery. Who should the project manager propose to conduct the readiness review?
option_1_content_en: A.The product owner is responsible for product vision and backlog management.
option_2_content_en: B.The quality control (QC) manager is responsible for ensuring delivery quality and efficiency.
option_3_content_en: C.The quality assurance (QA) manager is responsible for proposing measures for delivery improvement.
option_4_content_en: D.The subject matter expert (SME) is responsible for a deep understanding of the platform and requirements.

content_en: A project manager is working on a complex project with many stakeholders and conflicting priorities. Senior management asked the project manager to avoid "noise" specifically for political projects. Although it is difficult to find resources for the project, what should the project manager do to ensure smooth progress of the project?
option_1_content_en: A.Apply "If you do something nice for me I'll do something nice for you."
option_2_content_en: B.Be consistent with words and actions to avoid conflicts with the stakeholders.
option_3_content_en: C.Utilize compliments to obtain resources, and cooperate toward mutual goals.
option_4_content_en: D.Allocate the scarce resources efficiently to meet the needs of the project.

content_en: A project manager leads two highly motivated teams who typically work on 3-4 concurrent short projects with tight deadlines. Recently, communication, morale, and project performance have declined across teams and the project manager wants to improve team effectiveness and project success. What should the project manager do first?
option_1_content_en: A.Implement a new collaboration tool to facilitate communication between both teams.
option_2_content_en: B.Conduct individual performance reviews to identify and address performance issues within each team.
option_3_content_en: C.Organize team-building activities to increase team cohesion and boost morale.
option_4_content_en: D.Facilitate open communication sessions to identify and address underlying challenges.

content_en: What should a project manager do first when people are not following the project compliance process?
option_1_content_en: A.Escalate the issue to senior management or the sponsor
option_2_content_en: B.Initiate an audit process
option_3_content_en: C.Log the non-compliance and watch the progress
option_4_content_en: D.Understand the reasons for non-compliance

content_en: A project team is working on determining dependencies for approximately 350 activities for an ongoing project. Which actions should the project team take to manage dependencies successfully? (Choose 2).
option_1_content_en: A.Communicate the dependencies to the sponsor.
option_2_content_en: B.Assess and document the dependencies.
option_3_content_en: C.Communicate the dependencies to the customer.
option_4_content_en: D.Ensure that the dependencies are monitored.
option_5_content_en: E.Ensure you use only finish-to-start dependencies.

content_en: A customer requested a change in functionality for a product that will be delivered in the next sprint. The responsible specialist for this change is also assigned to a deliverable for another project. The project manager needs to negotiate the availability of the specialist. Who is responsible for confirming the specialist's availability?
option_1_content_en: A.Project sponsor
option_2_content_en: B.Functional manager
option_3_content_en: C.Product owner
option_4_content_en: D.Human resources

content_en: A project manager received an email from the factory regarding key equipment that will not be delivered as planned. The project manager must make alternative arrangements with other vendors to implement a temporary fix. Who is responsible for confirming the resource availability for the fix?
option_1_content_en: A.Service provider
option_2_content_en: B.Functional manager
option_3_content_en: C.Product owner
option_4_content_en: D.Human resources

content_en: A project manager has been on a complex project that began eight months ago. The project manager has a quality team that has been working hard, is motivated, and successful. What type of management and leadership should the project manager use at this stage?
option_1_content_en: A.Empower them to improve results
option_2_content_en: B.Support with periodic iterations and feedback
option_3_content_en: C.Help with conflict resolution
option_4_content_en: D.Feedback, coaching, or help only when they ask for it

content_en: A new member joined a project during the execution phase. The work requires strong collaboration with other team members. What should the project manager do to foster a collaborative environment?
option_1_content_en: A.Send an email to the project team asking them to collaborate with the new team member.
option_2_content_en: B.Share all information available and allocate time to explain in detail the work in progress.
option_3_content_en: C.Ask each member to describe their interests and experience in the next team meeting.
option_4_content_en: D.Organize a one-day workshop with the entire team to bring the new member up to speed.

content_en: A project manager notices that a project is not running well and deliverables are falling behind. What is the first step the project manager should take in order to make a decision on how to progress with the project?
option_1_content_en: A.Identify the problem.
option_2_content_en: B.Brainstorm solutions.
option_3_content_en: C.Establish a measurement criteria.
option_4_content_en: D.Set a goal.

content_en: In a five-year program, many project team members have joined and left the subprojects. Because of this, conflict among team members often occurs. Which technique should the project manager use to resolve the conflicts long term?
option_1_content_en: A.Forcing
option_2_content_en: B.Smoothing
option_3_content_en: C.Compromise
option_4_content_en: D.Problem-solving

content_en: During a retrospective meeting, team members show disengagement, stating that they are repeating the same ideas over and over. How can the project manager best handle this situation?
option_1_content_en: A.Ask the team members to pay more attention to the session even if they think they know what is coming.
option_2_content_en: B.Ask the team members to give their feedback, even if it is the same as other team members, to stress their points.
option_3_content_en: C.Encourage the team members to provide better feedback as they know the questions already.
option_4_content_en: D.Encourage the team to provide ideas for process improvement and support changes based on the feedback received.

content_en: During a daily meeting, the project team raised an impediment that one of the business subject matter experts is frequently changing the definition of done, and expressed their fear that this is a sign of distrust. What should the project manager do?
option_1_content_en: A.Remind the team to focus on their work, and commit to speak with the SME
option_2_content_en: B.Remind the product owner to support the team and speak with the SME
option_3_content_en: C.Remind the SME to keep the definition of done that was initially agreed
option_4_content_en: D.Remind the team that continuous feedback is important for success

content_en: A project manager is managing a project with a very aggressive delivery schedule and a firm completion date. The project requires expensive and fragile components that are prone to rework and rejections. The project manager is developing the vendor selection criteria. What should be the strategy for vendor selection?
option_1_content_en: A.Lowest price regardless of the vendor's warehouse location.
option_2_content_en: B.Acceptable price if the vendor is closer to the project site.
option_3_content_en: C.Project sponsor's recommendation based on past experience.
option_4_content_en: D.Team members' recommendations based on past experience.

content_en: A project manager just completed a project in an organization that values lessons learned. Leadership encourages all the project stakeholders to use the process, tools, and results from the lessons learned repository in future projects. Preparing to update the lessons learned repository, the project manager has gathered relevant project data and feedback. What should the project manager do next?
option_1_content_en: A.Store all the comments and recommendations received for future reference.
option_2_content_en: B.Analyze and organize the findings with the stakeholders to extract insights.
option_3_content_en: C.Document and share the findings with the stakeholders for review and feedback.
option_4_content_en: D.Retrieve all of the comments and recommendations received in the past.

content_en: An organization has decided to implement agile and a project manager with Scrum Master has been selected to coach the project team to understand agile delivery. One of the team members asks the project manager what servant leadership hierarchy means. How should the project manager respond?
option_1_content_en: A.Team members are supposed to serve their manager.
option_2_content_en: B.Managers are supposed to serve their team members.
option_3_content_en: C.Clients are supposed to serve the team members.
option_4_content_en: D.Team Members are supposed to serve their clients.

content_en: What is the main goal of a Visionary leadership style?
option_1_content_en: A.To support the team to self organise and decide a common vision.
option_2_content_en: B.To champion the adoption of the latest technologies and practices.
option_3_content_en: C.To provide long-term direction and engage the team to deliver it.
option_4_content_en: D.To prioritise and assign the tasks that are aligned with the vision.

content_en: During the execution phase of your project, a Resource Manager informed you that one of the experts allocated to your project had to be motivated in order to perform very well. What would be the recommended actions to address this issue?
option_1_content_en: A.Remind the functional manager that is his duty to motivate his team
option_2_content_en: B.Remind the team member that there are penalties for bad behaviours.
option_3_content_en: C.Remind the team member that there are financial incentives for the team.
option_4_content_en: D.Remind the team member their important role and how it will be rewarded.

content_en: A project manager is working on a project with internal stakeholders only and was warned by the project sponsor that some stakeholders require special attention. The organization is very hierarchical. Which of the following models should be used in this instance?
option_1_content_en: A.Power-Interest Grid
option_2_content_en: B.Power-Influence Grid
option_3_content_en: C.Interest-Influence Grid
option_4_content_en: D.Interest-Impact Grid

content_en: During project execution, a team member made a mistake resulting in a 1-week delay to the project schedule. What should the project manager do with regard to this error and delay?
option_1_content_en: A.Discuss the issue with the team, look for solutions, and offer to help and support the team.
option_2_content_en: B.Make sure the impact of this mistake is understood by the team member who made the mistake.
option_3_content_en: C.Escalate the issue to senior management to make sure a similar mistake won't happen again.
option_4_content_en: D.Find a solution, communicate it to the team, and reinforce that it should be implemented now.

content_en: A project manager is involved in an e-commerce development project. The project has been completed successfully using the hybrid model and initiated operations handover. The project manager notices that the development team is relaxed and not spending time on the handover process, which is impacting application support. How should the project manager handle this situation?
option_1_content_en: A.Confront the development team and demand their immediate attention to the handover process.
option_2_content_en: B.Meet with the development team to discuss the importance of the handover process and its impact on application support.
option_3_content_en: C.Delegate the responsibility of the handover process to another team member to ensure it gets done properly.
option_4_content_en: D.Disregard the issue and expect that the development team will address and resolve the issue on their own.

content_en: A project manager is handling virtual teams around the world. What should the project manager do to overcome cross-cultural differences?
option_1_content_en: A.Create grapevine communication channels and invite team members to contribute freely
option_2_content_en: B.Nurture stronger personal boundaries and individual sovereignty
option_3_content_en: C.Create an environment where team members can openly communicate
option_4_content_en: D.Create a shared understanding of team goals and objectives

content_en: For virtual teams, the following are the boundaries that teams need to work through for successful project outcomes, except:
option_1_content_en: A.Interpersonal interactions and developing relational capital
option_2_content_en: B.Working practices and routines
option_3_content_en: C.Knowledge diversity
option_4_content_en: D.Personal Convenience

content_en: A project manager is assigned to a project that will ensure that the organization meets regulatory compliance with new legislation. In which phase of the project should the project manager document compliance objectives?
option_1_content_en: A.Initiation phase
option_2_content_en: B.Planning phase
option_3_content_en: C.Execution phase
option_4_content_en: D.Closing phase

content_en: A project manager is on a project that has a significant dependence on market changes. The PMO recommended to use an agile approach and the project manager scheduled reference checks to select the implementation partner. To be successful, agile needs a high level of trust between the client and vendor. Which of the following aspects should the project manager look for to build trust that the vendor can deliver? (Choose 2).
option_1_content_en: A.Processes and tools - to ensure that the vendor used an efficient and repeatable delivery approach
option_2_content_en: B.Technical excellence - to ensure that the deliverables were completed as soon as possible and of a high quality
option_3_content_en: C.Perseverance - to ensure that the vendor overcome the challenges inherent to frequent scope change
option_4_content_en: D.Planning skills - to ensure that the vendor met the costs and milestones agreed in the contract

content_en: A project has begun to develop a new software application that will be used by the company's sales team. The project is expected to take six months to complete and has a budget of $100,000. The project manager has identified software development tools, hardware, and training to be procured. What is the most important thing for the project manager to do while developing the procurement plan?
option_1_content_en: A.Ensure that all resources will be procured within budget.
option_2_content_en: B.Ensure that the project is on schedule with no delays.
option_3_content_en: C.Ensure that all procured resources are of great quality.
option_4_content_en: D.Ensure that all resources will be procured on schedule.

content_en: The project manager for a complex project, aimed at improving the company's financial results, decides to use the Expected Monetary Value (EMV) method to select the best strategy. To achieve this, the project team defines three scenarios with the following probabilities of outcome: scenario 1 (25%), scenario 2 (50%), and scenario 3 (25%) for strategy A, with scores $160, $120, and -$20 respectively. The other strategy, strategy B, scored an EMV of $75. Which strategy will the project manager prefer?
option_1_content_en: A.Strategy A with an EMV score for Strategy A of 65.
option_2_content_en: B.Strategy B with an EMV score for Strategy B of 75.
option_3_content_en: C.Strategy A with an EMV score for Strategy A of 95.
option_4_content_en: D.Strategy B with an EMV score for Strategy A of 95.

content_en: A project manager is working on a project that is part of a large business transformation initiative. The project has gained support from the quality department's executives. Even though the scope is not yet finalized, the sponsor was able to obtain a large contingency budget to cover any scope changes and they assured the project manager that money is not an issue. All of these changes are expedited due to the strategic importance of the project. What should be the project manager's primary focus in developing the strategy to manage change?
option_1_content_en: A.Develop a stakeholder needs assessment
option_2_content_en: B.Develop a work breakdown structure (WBS)
option_3_content_en: C.Develop a risk breakdown structure (RBS)
option_4_content_en: D.Develop an organizational communication plan

content_en: A majority portion of a local company was recently sold to an international company. The new parent company is mandating the use of health, safety, and environmental (HSE) regulations for all projects in the local company. What should the project managers do to remain compliant?
option_1_content_en: A.Wait for the functional department responsible for HSE regulations to communicate the process change.
option_2_content_en: B.Ask the functional department responsible for HSE regulations to assign a new team member.
option_3_content_en: C.Speak with the project sponsor to get clarification about the new HSE regulations.
option_4_content_en: D.Meet with the HSE team to understand the impact of the new regulations on the projects.

content_en: A project manager is finishing a project and the sponsor is requesting insights on benefits realization. How can the project manager calculate project outcomes value?
option_1_content_en: A.Evaluate qualitative and quantitative project benefits.
option_2_content_en: B.Price tangible benefits and divide them by expenses.
option_3_content_en: C.Conduct a retrospective financial assessment.
option_4_content_en: D.Assess outcomes and compare them to the budget.

content_en: Teams A and B are working on two different agile projects for the same customer. They are using the same method to calculate units of work, and each iteration is 2 weeks long. In the first two iterations, team A completed 150 units of work and team B completed 200 units of work. Both teams' tasks are getting completed as planned. The customer reported 5 errors per unit of work for Team A and 10 errors per unit of work for Team B. What conclusion should the project manager have regarding the teams and their performances?
option_1_content_en: A.Team B is performing better than Team A as they have completed more units of work in the same duration.
option_2_content_en: B.Teams A and B have completed their tasks as planned; therefore, they are both performing equally.
option_3_content_en: C.Team A is performing better than Team B because there are fewer errors per unit of work.
option_4_content_en: D.The teams have completed just two iterations; therefore, it is too early to assess their performance.

content_en: A complex technology project is in the execution phase. New technologies are added to the backlog based on customer requirements, which will involve significant changes to the deliverable. What should the project manager do to satisfy the customer?
option_1_content_en: A.Replan the sprints and releases to meet every expectation of the customer.
option_2_content_en: B.Manage customer expectations based on the organization's business needs.
option_3_content_en: C.Accept the new requirements, and schedule meetings to plan a new release schedule.
option_4_content_en: D.Push the project team to increase flexibility and accept the new challenge.

content_en: A parent company announces an integration project for all of its subsidiary companies. The integration project covers the legal, human resources (HR), and finance departments of the subsidiary companies. Senior management is investing in this as the company's first agile project and a new project manager has been assigned. What should the project manager do first?
option_1_content_en: A.Meet with the stakeholders to discuss risks.
option_2_content_en: B.Develop a team charter.
option_3_content_en: C.Plan to enhance the team's agile maturity level.
option_4_content_en: D.Develop a transition strategy.

content_en: During a product backlog refinement meeting, a stakeholder from the legal department and the product owner disagree on the prioritization of a particular item. The product owner states that the current prioritization is adding maximum value to the project, and the stakeholder states that the item should be prioritized because it is a governmental compliance requirement. What should the project manager do in this situation?
option_1_content_en: A.Yield to the product owner's prioritization authority and remind the stakeholder that it is not their responsibility.
option_2_content_en: B.Examine previous situations in the lessons learned register to find a solution and prioritize the backlog accordingly.
option_3_content_en: C.Use negotiation techniques to convince the product owner to prioritize the backlog as suggested by the stakeholder.
option_4_content_en: D.Facilitate a discussion between the product owner and the stakeholder to discuss their perspectives and concerns.

content_en: An international company is implementing an innovative technology at one of its production plants. The technology has already demonstrated positive returns at another site. What should the project manager consider as a key aspect of the successful implementation of this technology?
option_1_content_en: A.Assess the business case to ensure the return on investment (ROI) meets or exceeds the performance indicators of the first site.
option_2_content_en: B.Consult with the technology manager to ensure the technology can fit in the new site.
option_3_content_en: C.Conduct an information-sharing workshop to present the new technology and its benefits to the new site's stakeholders.
option_4_content_en: D.Develop the project charter for implementation at the new site using the lessons learned from the first site.

content_en: During final inspection of a deliverable, the quality team observes that there is a deviation on a particular component. The customer, however, has not indicated anything with regard to this in its specifications. What should the project manager do?
option_1_content_en: A.Raise the matter to a technical expert.
option_2_content_en: B.Conduct a quality assurance audit.
option_3_content_en: C.Approve the deliverable as it does not deviate from any customer specifications.
option_4_content_en: D.Reject the deliverable, citing deviation from the project specifications.

content_en: During a new technology project, confusion arises due to the lack of a clearly defined and communicated future state of the product. What should the project manager do next?
option_1_content_en: A.Create and get approval on a benefits management plan.
option_2_content_en: B.Ask the project sponsor what the project outcome should be.
option_3_content_en: C.Discuss the scope and objectives with the functional owner.
option_4_content_en: D.Review the project's business case to identify alternatives.

content_en: A new regulation has been approved that will impact the deliverables in the fourth phase of the project. The delivery is following an iterative approach and is currently completing the second phase. What should the project manager do next? What should the project manager do next?
option_1_content_en: A.Consult with the project sponsor to discuss a cost increase.
option_2_content_en: B.Get approval for the additional budget from the steering committee.
option_3_content_en: C.Meet with subject matter experts (SMEs) to assess the impact to objectives.
option_4_content_en: D.Acquire approval for an exception to the implementation of the new regulation.

content_en: A project manager is leading a wastewater treatment project for a factory. During project execution, the government unexpectedly releases new environmental protection standards that are stricter than the previous standards. To ensure compliance with these updated regulations, what should the project manager's initial course of action be?
option_1_content_en: A.Meet with the project team to assess the implications of the new government regulations on the project requirements.
option_2_content_en: B.Review the project's risk register to determine if this change was previously documented as a potential risk to the project.
option_3_content_en: C.Draft a formal change request detailing the adjustments and submit it to the change control board (CCB) for evaluation.
option_4_content_en: D. Initiate discussions with the government agency to negotiate a revised timeline for adopting the new environmental standards.

content_en: A team member suggests using a new product to speed up feature development, but this will increase the project budget. The project team is taking an incremental approach to product development, and the product owner is responsible for prioritizing and managing the product backlog. What should the project manager do first?
option_1_content_en: A.Consult the product owner and present the benefits and drawbacks of using the new product.
option_2_content_en: B.Review and update the cost management plan to accommodate the potential budget impact.
option_3_content_en: C.Request additional funding for the implementation of the new product from the project sponsor.
option_4_content_en: D.Revise the acceptance criteria for the user stories to incorporate the new product effectively.

content_en: A project manager is currently overseeing a project from its inception and is aware that there are several assumptions and dependencies integral to the project's success. What action should the project manager take in this situation?
option_1_content_en: A.Seek support from the project sponsor to allocate a dedicated resource to monitor and track benefits realization.
option_2_content_en: B.Instruct the project team to record all the assumptions and track all the changes.
option_3_content_en: C.Facilitate a brainstorming session with the project team to formulate a comprehensive risk mitigation plan.
option_4_content_en: D.Ask the project management office (PMO) to implement a benefits measurement system to verify benefit metrics and associated risks.

content_en: A new customer relations database is being deployed. The schedule calls for migration from the previous system to occur over one weekend. However, some key stakeholders believe it may take more time for the migration. What should the project manager do?
option_1_content_en: A.Assess the concerns and risks of not deploying within the scheduled time frame and react accordingly.
option_2_content_en: B.Change the deployment plan such that additional resources are available to perform the weekend deployment.
option_3_content_en: C.Review and revise as necessary the risk management plan
option_4_content_en: D.Modify the schedule to increase the time frame of the deployment plan.

content_en: A team is working on a new product using a gated approach. After the third sprint they noticed that the market needs may be changing, and the product may not fit the new market needs. What should the project manager do next?
option_1_content_en: A.Survey the market for possible impacts on the project.
option_2_content_en: B.Change the product’s scope to meet the new needs.
option_3_content_en: C.Finalize the product on time and budget to launch as planned.
option_4_content_en: D.Review the backlog to see the impact of the new needs.

content_en: After several interviews with key stakeholders and checking the project charter, a project manager found that the current project organizational structure is no longer appropriate for the project's strategic goals. What should the project manager do next?
option_1_content_en: A.Assess the lessons learned documents and validate which organizational structure was used in the past for similar projects.
option_2_content_en: B.Ask the team to document the risk in the project risk register and develop a risk response plan accordingly.
option_3_content_en: C.Evaluate the gaps between the current organizational structure and the expected project benefits to determine required actions.
option_4_content_en: D.Ask the team to review the project charter and evaluate the project objectives for relevance.

content_en: A company is going through an organizational change. Most of the senior management has changed, including the project manager's direct supervisor. The supervisor has an aggressive working style, and has made critical comments to the project manager regarding the ongoing project, without really understanding the situation. The project manager feels uncomfortable working with the new supervisor. What should the project manager do next?
option_1_content_en: A.Hold a project review meeting to explain the key points of the project to the new supervisor.
option_2_content_en: B.Apply the new supervisor's recommendations to the project.
option_3_content_en: C.Evaluate the impact of the organizational change to the project.
option_4_content_en: D.Communicate to the project team that they need to be ready to embrace change.

content_en: During the last iteration of planning in an agile project, the team discovers that mandatory regulations were not included in the minimum viable product (MVP). What should the project manager do?
option_1_content_en: A.Ask the team to include this regulatory requirement in the iteration backlog.
option_2_content_en: B.Ask the product owner to review the priority of this regulatory requirement.
option_3_content_en: C.Ask the stakeholders to review the priority of this regulatory requirement.
option_4_content_en: D.Ask the sponsor for approval to include this regulatory requirement in the iteration backlog.

content_en: A project manager had just started a long-term project when the government implemented new legislation that all engineers working in the state need to be registered. Registration is based on work area, experience, and professional development completed in the last 3 years. Due to budget constraints in the company for the past three years, there were limited opportunities for engineers to gain formal professional development. How should the project manager handle the situation?
option_1_content_en: A.Send a request to the change management board to assess the situation.
option_2_content_en: B.Review the team's skills matrix and update the resource management plan.
option_3_content_en: C.Send all of the engineers to professional development to meet the requirements.
option_4_content_en: D.Inform the engineers that they need to be registered to keep working for the company.

content_en: What approach should a project manager employ to encourage collaboration among developers in an agile development model? Behavior-driven development builds on established test-driven practices including using a shared domain language to encourage closer collaboration and understanding within the team.
option_1_content_en: A.Acceptance testing
option_2_content_en: B.Behavior-driven development
option_3_content_en: C.Joint application development
option_4_content_en: D.Rapid application development

content_en: During a business status meeting, the project manager acknowledges that several market conditions have recently changed dramatically. As a result, the expected value of the project in progress may be threatened. What should the project manager do next?
option_1_content_en: A.Stop the project immediately due to uncertainty that the project will deliver the expected value.
option_2_content_en: B.Continue with the project since the project manager has not been formally informed of any change in market conditions.
option_3_content_en: C.Ask the project team to investigate the evolution of market conditions during the last 6 months.
option_4_content_en: D.Meet with the project sponsor to discuss the information and ask if the organization still supports delivery of the project.

content_en: The local government regulator has issued a notification to all companies regarding a new project aimed at facilitating information reporting to an international regulator. However, due to the dynamic nature of the project, there is a possibility of changing requirements while the delivery date remains fixed. The project manager assigned to this initiative is concerned about the uncertainty and the short timeline for delivery. How should the project manager best prepare to address this situation?
option_1_content_en: A.Implement iterative and incremental approaches in relevant areas of the project to adapt to changing requirements.
option_2_content_en: B.Meet with the sponsor to determine a detailed project schedule to ensure that the project is completed on time.
option_3_content_en: C.Develop a detailed contingency plan using the crashing technique to expedite project activities as needed.
option_4_content_en: D.Enhance communication strategies and engagement with the local government to ensure alignment and timely updates.

content_en: A project manager has started developing a plan for a new project. During the first planning meeting, the stakeholders ask about the project's value and how it relates to the organization's goals. What should the project manager do next?
option_1_content_en: A.Refer the stakeholders to the scope management plan.
option_2_content_en: B.Refer the stakeholders to the project charter.
option_3_content_en: C.Invite the project sponsor to join the meeting to address questions.
option_4_content_en: D.Ask the project management office (PMO) to provide the necessary documentation.

content_en: A project manager is leading a remote home office implementation. The project manager is surprised with early signs of resistance from key stakeholders in the organization. The key stakeholders strongly disagree with the change and will require more persuasion than the project manager originally expected. Which two tools and techniques should be used to identify the organizational and project influence of the stakeholders? (Choose two)
option_1_content_en: A.Stakeholder matrix
option_2_content_en: B.RACI chart
option_3_content_en: C.Stakeholder analysis
option_4_content_en: D.Stakeholder map

content_en: A company has undertaken a large transformation project to prepare itself for the changing economy. During the execution of the transformation project, a new technology emerges that was not foreseen in the risk management plan. What should the project manager do?
option_1_content_en: A.Escalate this to the IT department and organize training for the impacted team members.
option_2_content_en: B.Revisit the procurement management plan and identify the impacted contracts for upcoming purchases.
option_3_content_en: C.Revisit the risk management plan and apply the project risk planning process.
option_4_content_en: D.Escalate the issue to the next steering committee and facilitate a brainstorming meeting.

content_en: A critical software development project has been in development for the past six sprints. A demonstration for stakeholders took place two days before the final sprint, in which a new stakeholder voiced that the product would not meet expectations for the market. What should the project manager do next?
option_1_content_en: A.Discuss the matter with the project sponsor and new stakeholder and request them to fix the expectation issue.
option_2_content_en: B.Review the scope and plan of the project with the new stakeholder.
option_3_content_en: C.Review the list of required tasks with the development team and new stakeholder.
option_4_content_en: D.Follow the change management plan and revise the scope and plan upon the stakeholders' request.

content_en: While executing a critical iterative phase of a project, a problem previously identified as a risk just became a confirmed issue, which has halted progress. After entering the new item in the issue log, what should the project manager do next?
option_1_content_en: A.Increase communications and involve stakeholders in the resolution whenever necessary.
option_2_content_en: B.Change the communications management plan and assign ownership to a team member.
option_3_content_en: C.Escalate the issue within the team during the next project retrospective meeting.
option_4_content_en: D.Add the issue to the product backlog to bring it into focus during the current sprint.

content_en: During the execution phase of a project, a new project manager is assigned to replace the previous project manager. As the project manager starts managing the project, they discover that team performance is significantly decreasing, which is impacting the project's key performance indicators (KPIs). This team has delivered good performance on similar projects in the past. What should the project manager do next to improve this situation?
option_1_content_en: A.Review the resource management plan and organizational assets.
option_2_content_en: B.Implement compression techniques to bring the project back on track.
option_3_content_en: C.Call for a team meeting to identify the root cause for the declining performance.
option_4_content_en: D.Estimate the baseline impacts and submit a change request.

content_en: A project team has recently finished a sprint for developing two features for a fleet management system. Although the team delivered the required features, they encountered several issues and conflicts during the sprint. Team members were upset about this experience and are now showing a lack of motivation due to what has occurred. What can the project manager do to help increase the team's motivation and engagement with the project?
option_1_content_en: A.Set up one-on-one meetings with the project team members.
option_2_content_en: B.Review sprint progress with the project team members.
option_3_content_en: C.Review sprint planning procedures with the project team members.
option_4_content_en: D.Perform a sprint retrospective with the project team members.

content_en: A key project stakeholder showed interest in the beginning of a complex agile project but has become less involved as the sprint has progressed due to additional responsibilities. A few sprints later, the key stakeholder rejected a feature deliverable. The team is reworking the rejected deliverable for the next sprint. What should the project manager have done to avoid this situation?
option_1_content_en: A.Documented the project vision and objectives.
option_2_content_en: B.Analyzed the changes in stakeholder attributes.
option_3_content_en: C.Involved the key stakeholders in the decision-making process.
option_4_content_en: D.Customized stakeholder communications based on the stakeholders' needs.

content_en: A startup in its early stages has been acquired by a major company. In light of this new scenario, the project manager has been requested to review the project's roadmap. What should the project manager do?
option_1_content_en: A.Determine the definition of value with the stakeholders and reprioritize the project's backlog accordingly.
option_2_content_en: B.Reprioritize the project's backlog by prioritizing those features that maximize the return on investment (ROI).
option_3_content_en: C.Reprioritize the roadmap by focusing on long-term benefits and reducing the technical debt.
option_4_content_en: D.Launch a customer survey to better evaluate the key project features prior to reprioritizing the roadmap.

content_en: A project manager has been assigned to a project to implement an asset health management system. The executive business sponsor has indicated that the system is expected to improve the quality of operations and extend the life span of the assets. What should the project manager do in order to demonstrate the business value once the system is in production?
option_1_content_en: A.Establish critical success criteria, potential cost savings, and ongoing performance metrics for the project.
option_2_content_en: B.Write test cases to align with the business values and ensure that acceptance criteria are clear during user acceptance testing (UAT).
option_3_content_en: C.Verify that all requirements and acceptance criteria are in alignment with the business value and expectations.
option_4_content_en: D.Validate the return on investment (ROI), review the current asset performance, and use it as a benchmark for future measurements.

content_en: A project manager is working on a project that will deliver a solution in country A. Due to the potential for a security breach, country A's government is banning the technology that will be used in the project's solution, adversely affecting the project. The project manager is close to completing the installation for the project after already procuring the materials and the banned technology. What should the project manager do?
option_1_content_en: A.Review the project management plan and follow the process for change control.
option_2_content_en: B.Request that the legal team review the change and determine the appropriate response.
option_3_content_en: C.Meet with the project sponsor about the issue and request direction for next steps.
option_4_content_en: D.Inform the customer that the project cannot deliver the defined scope.

content_en: A project manager is asked to manage a project that will allow the company to comply with a new, upcoming regulation. Just after project kick-off, the scope is modified to have the project team now work on specific tasks, while a global team will manage the program for several countries in parallel. The project management plan has not yet been shared, and the deadline to complete the project is fixed. What should the project manager do to handle the scope and changes?
option_1_content_en: A.Create a risk entry in the risk management plan due to the lack of a global project management plan.
option_2_content_en: B.Formalize the change in the scope with the project sponsor to limit accountability for the specific tasks.
option_3_content_en: C.Review the organizational process assets (OPAs) from similar situations and the approaches that were implemented.
option_4_content_en: D.Define an initial backlog and start working on the clearest tasks, then incrementally refine the scope.

content_en: A project manager notices that the project is behind schedule because materials delivery was delayed. The procurement team informs the project manager that new government-imposed rules for the procurement of these materials caused this delay. In what plan should these new rules be documented?
option_1_content_en: A.Procurement management
option_2_content_en: B.Communications management
option_3_content_en: C.Stakeholder engagement
option_4_content_en: D.Schedule management

content_en: During project execution, an issue arises that requires additional budget and time to resolve the issue. The project team did not identify this issue as a risk during risk management planning. The project sponsor points out that this risk has occurred on past projects. What should the project manager have done to avoid this oversight?
option_1_content_en: A.Reviewed the risk management plan.
option_2_content_en: B.Confirmed organizational risk appetite.
option_3_content_en: C.Reviewed the lessons learned register.
option_4_content_en: D.Allocated additional contingency reserves.

content_en: The implementation of a business requirement for an IT project impacts several applications. The application owner notices that changes to a function in application X can be started only upon completion of the development of a new feature in application Y. This is an example of what dependency?
option_1_content_en: A.Start-to-start (SS)
option_2_content_en: B.Finish-to-start (FS)
option_3_content_en: C.Start-to-finish (SF)
option_4_content_en: D.Finish-to-finish (FF)

content_en: Due to organizational changes, a key stakeholder is replaced by a new employee. The next status review meeting to update project progress will not take place until next month. What should the project manager do next?
option_1_content_en: A.Schedule a separate meeting with the new stakeholder to brief them on project status.
option_2_content_en: B.Prepare and send a project status report to the new stakeholder for review.
option_3_content_en: C.Seek advice from the project sponsor on how to obtain support from the new stakeholder.
option_4_content_en: D.Wait for the next communication window to share information with the new stakeholder.

content_en: A project team discovers an opportunity to enhance software without impacting the budget or schedule. The team makes the enhancement without proper documentation, which later causes production issues. What process should have been conducted to prevent this?
option_1_content_en: A.Control Schedule
option_2_content_en: B.Perform Qualitative Risk Analysis
option_3_content_en: C.Plan Scope Management
option_4_content_en: D.Perform Integrated Change Control

content_en: A pilot project is ready to close and the project team wants to capture the challenges that were overcome and the opportunities for future work. Where will they document this information?
option_1_content_en: A.Organizational process assets updates
option_2_content_en: B.Work performance report
option_3_content_en: C.Project management plan
option_4_content_en: D.Lessons learned register

content_en: A project's original budget at completion (BAC) was calculated as US$100,000, but the estimate at completion (EAC) is US$120,000. If the schedule performance index (SPI) is equal to 1, what is the cost performance index (CPI)?
option_1_content_en: A.Equal to 1.2
option_2_content_en: B.Less than 1
option_3_content_en: C.Equal to 1
option_4_content_en: D.Greater than 1

content_en: While reviewing project documentation, a project manager discovers that modifications were made without proper approvals. What should the project manager do next?
option_1_content_en: A.Escalate the issue to the project management office (PMO).
option_2_content_en: B.Review the change management plan.
option_3_content_en: C.Review the requirements management plan.
option_4_content_en: D.Escalate the issue to the project sponsor.

content_en: A project management team is developing a project management information system (PMIS) as a collaboration tool for internal and external stakeholders. The project manager wants to develop a dashboard component within the system that will be updated with information on projects' performance. What should the project manager do first?
option_1_content_en: A.Identify the data that will be displayed.
option_2_content_en: B.Select the appropriate visualization tools.
option_3_content_en: C.Determine the frequency of dashboard updates.
option_4_content_en: D.Define the communication needs of the stakeholders.

content_en: A design project is ready to be transferred to production. What activity is required for phase closure?
