option_1_content_en: A.Determine summary budget.
option_2_content_en: B.Manage quality.
option_3_content_en: C.Ensure preventive actions are completed.
option_4_content_en: D.Record impacts of tailoring to any process.

content_en: A geographically dispersed team successfully completed a project. The project manager wants to quickly obtain the team's feedback for statistical analysis. What method should the project manager use?
option_1_content_en: A.Video conference
option_2_content_en: B.Focus group
option_3_content_en: C.Questionnaires
option_4_content_en: D.Email

content_en: At the completion of a project, customer agreement cannot be achieved through negotiations. What should the project manager do next?
option_1_content_en: A.Inform project team members.
option_2_content_en: B.Initiate litigation since all work was completed.
option_3_content_en: C.Start the closing phase.
option_4_content_en: D.Explore arbitration.

content_en: During a project's execution, a previously unidentified stakeholder within the customer's organization requests a change that could affect the project's scope. The stakeholder's influence within the customer's organization is strong. What should the project manager do first?
option_1_content_en: A.Schedule a meeting and, based on the outcome, update the project management plan.
option_2_content_en: B.Issue a change request to the change control board (CCB).
option_3_content_en: C.Identify the new stakeholder and update the stakeholder register.
option_4_content_en: D.Meet with all stakeholders to discuss the change.

content_en: While forming the team to work on a global project with incremental deliveries, the project leader shared the performance measurement plan with the team. Team members did not appreciate the proposed plan, as they expressed it is not realistic. What should the project leader do to ensure the team member's engagement in the implementation of the performance management plan?
option_1_content_en: A.Ask the team members to abide by the plan, otherwise, they will not be properly appraised.
option_2_content_en: B.Include self-assessments at the start, middle, and end of the project to increase the autonomy of the team.
option_3_content_en: C.Ask the human resources team to deliver a presentation about the company's performance measurements.
option_4_content_en: D.Talk to the team member on a one-on-one basis to convince them about the benefits of the proposed plan.

content_en: A project manager recently completed a project in which they resolved numerous sub-standard deliverables rejected by the customer. The project manager noticed that when thirty (30) prioritized defects of the one hundred (100) total identified for the project were resolved, this resulted in the customer satisfaction feedback increasing to 100% and all deliverables being accepted. Which principle does this occurrence demonstrate?
option_1_content_en: A.Pareto
option_2_content_en: B.Monte Carlo
option_3_content_en: C.Kaizen
option_4_content_en: D.Voice of customer

content_en: What are the main outputs of the risk identification process?
option_1_content_en: A.Risk report and risk register
option_2_content_en: B.Risk report, risk register, and project documents updates
option_3_content_en: C.Risk management plan, risk register, and risk responses
option_4_content_en: D.Risk report, probability, and impact matrix

content_en: While conducting a retrospective meeting, team members were surprised from the performance results of the team shared by the project lead. The team have all expressed their ignorance of the measurements and availability of the different tools in place. What should have the project lead done to avoid this situation?
option_1_content_en: A.Ask the HR to explain the different performance measurement tools
option_2_content_en: B.Inform the team members to fill in feedback on a regular basis
option_3_content_en: C.Provide Team members with continuous feedback about their performance
option_4_content_en: D.Planning and define a clear performance measurement framework

content_en: While forming a team to work on a global project, the project leader calls for an ice breaker meeting between the diverse team members. What should the project manager do to motivate the team to express their expectations?
option_1_content_en: A.Ask the team members to write their expectations on post notes
option_2_content_en: B.Ask direct questions to each team member and wait for their responses
option_3_content_en: C.Inform the team members about the incentives of the project success
option_4_content_en: D.Start by doing a team self-assessment to increase team autonomy

content_en: A virtual project team is composed of members from various countries with cultural differences. The project manager is concerned that cultural differences may lead to miscommunication and conflict. What should the project manager do to effectively mitigate against potential conflicts?
option_1_content_en: A.Collaboratively define and communicate the project-specific ground rules.
option_2_content_en: B.Require that all communications within the project team are in written form.
option_3_content_en: C.Appoint the senior member of one country's team to act as arbitrator if a conflict arises.
option_4_content_en: D.Make all conflict resolution decisions and then inform the team.

content_en: A project manager has asked every team member involved in a conflict to make a sacrifice to resolve the situation. This approach corresponds to which conflict resolution technique?
option_1_content_en: A.Compromise/reconcile
option_2_content_en: B.Collaborate/problem solve
option_3_content_en: C.Smooth/accommodate
option_4_content_en: D.Withdraw/avoid

content_en: Which statement correctly differentiates management from leadership?
option_1_content_en: A.Managers ask how and when; leaders ask what and why.
option_2_content_en: B.Managers focus on long-term goals; leaders focus on short-term goals.
option_3_content_en: C.Managers challenge the status quo; leaders accept the status quo.
option_4_content_en: D.Managers inspire trust; leaders rely on control.

content_en: A project manager in an organization selects an agile delivery for a cutting-edge technology project. The project manager develops a professional network and wants the product owner to join this network. Which two benefits will the project manager use to encourage the product owner to join and participate in the network? (Choose two).
option_1_content_en: A.Access to global knowledge and workforce
option_2_content_en: B.Lower risk and cost
option_3_content_en: C.Opportunity to engage with resources
option_4_content_en: D.Formal professional network

content_en: A project manager is working in an agile environment on a project that will span a few years. The end user asks for a pilot in the first quarter of the project. What are the optimal times to conduct a formal readiness review? (Choose two).
option_1_content_en: A.Every quarter
option_2_content_en: B.Every month
option_3_content_en: C.At major handoff points
option_4_content_en: D.At the beginning of the pilot
option_5_content_en: E.At the end of the pilot

content_en: A project manager is working on a complex project that includes many stakeholders with conflicting priorities. What should the project manager do to reduce conflict?
option_1_content_en: A.Document and sign off on all deliverables in the project.
option_2_content_en: B.Take the lead in all aspects of the negotiations.
option_3_content_en: C.Negotiate all aspects with help from the project management office (PMO).
option_4_content_en: D.Negotiate all aspects using agile for easy deliveries.

content_en: A project team in the middle of an incremental delivery project decided they need the help of a subject matter expert (SME) who is working in a different department. The project team asked the SME to join their team and assist in a specific task and they informed the project leader about this action. What should the project manager do?
option_1_content_en: A.Check the project budget and assess the impact and feasibility of adding an additional resource
option_2_content_en: B.Talk with the project sponsor and get approval, explaining that this resource is important and crucial
option_3_content_en: C.Talk to the functional manager of this needed resource and check their availability and bandwidth
option_4_content_en: D.Facilitate the coordination of resources with the needed resources based on the teams working agreement

content_en: A project team is actively engaged in the preparation of the last delivery before the final product is live in production. What should the project manager do to make sure that the whole team is in full sync?
option_1_content_en: A.Ensure the team is attending the daily meetings and participating actively
option_2_content_en: B.Ensure that the needed information is available and accessible to each and every member
option_3_content_en: C.Ensure to visualize the work to be done on a white board visual and accessible to all
option_4_content_en: D.Ensure there is a room for the team to have regular conversation whenever needed

content_en: A project leader and a product owner had a side conversation about the status of the next delivery. The product owner raised concerns about the way the architecture owner is dealing with the coming delivery. What should the project leader do to address this issue?
option_1_content_en: A.Reassure the product owner not to worry and ask them to attend the daily meetings.
option_2_content_en: B.Share the product owner's concerns with the architecture owner and ask for their opinion.
option_3_content_en: C.Ask the product owner not to get involved and ignore the concerns until after the delivery.
option_4_content_en: D.Make sure that team members attend daily meetings to discuss and resolve issues.

content_en: During the development of a project, the project manager noticed that results are not as good as expected. Which tool or document shows which elements are impacting the key metrics?
option_1_content_en: A.Pareto chart
option_2_content_en: B.Run chart
option_3_content_en: C.Project charter
option_4_content_en: D.Risk register

content_en: A project manager must make decisions daily, regardless of the decision's level of importance or criticality. What should a project manager do to ensure their decisions are unbiased and rational?
option_1_content_en: A.Utilize data without checking for accuracy
option_2_content_en: B.Understand they cannot achieve everything
option_3_content_en: C.Make decisions quickly
option_4_content_en: D.Make decisions only when the results are certain

content_en: A project manager begins to notice disengaged members arriving late, not delivering on time, not attending meetings, and producing low-quality deliveries. What action should the project manager take?
option_1_content_en: A.Investigate the reason for the team members' disengaged behavior and boost morale and participation.
option_2_content_en: B.Ask the team members to change the way they are working to match the newest work trends.
option_3_content_en: C.Encourage the team to double their efforts to pick up the slack from the disengaged team members.
option_4_content_en: D.Request that the team members abandon the process that is slowing their progress.

content_en: A project manager is helping their organization transition from utilizing predictive methods to agile methods. One team member asks when high-level requirements definition and solution design activities should be done in an agile methodology. How should the project manager respond?
option_1_content_en: A.In agile, these activities must start as soon as the project team is assembled, preferably in sprint one.
option_2_content_en: B.In agile, the team should plan to perform some of these activities as part of sprint zero before starting development.
option_3_content_en: C.In agile, the team should avoid waste, so these activities must be done as part of development.
option_4_content_en: D.In agile, the team follows the last responsible moment strategy and should defer those activities as much as possible.

content_en: A project manager is leading an agile project that is in the execution phase. After a couple of sprints, the project manager realizes that the team's estimates are not realistic. How should the project manager have acted to avoid this?
option_1_content_en: A.Ask the team to address this issue at the next the retrospective to avoid impacting the sprint in progress.
option_2_content_en: B.Obtain approval from project sponsor to add a contingency buffer to the sprint, and change the end date.
option_3_content_en: C.Ask the team to address this issue at the next standup, and meet the commitment for the sprint in progress.
option_4_content_en: D.Organize product backlog refinement sessions to better understand the scope and review estimations.

content_en: A delivery milestone for a project is fast approaching, but an item that is planned to be completed is at risk. A team member begins to act defensively and is blaming others for this issue. How should the project manager have acted to avoid this?
option_1_content_en: A.Established ground rules for interaction that the whole team must follow.
option_2_content_en: B.Established and maintained meaningful relationships between team members.
option_3_content_en: C.Established formal patterns of authority, responsibility, and accountability.
option_4_content_en: D.Established clear delegation and accountability-sharing principles.

content_en: A project manager is managing a project whose sponsor has asked why some of the components of the project were developed in-house. Where can this information be found?
option_1_content_en: A.In the Procurement Management Plan, under build vs. buy decisions
option_2_content_en: B.In the Project Charter, under the assumptions and constraints section
option_3_content_en: C.In the Technical Architecture Document, under solution boundaries
option_4_content_en: D.In the Solution Architecture Document, under project purpose and justification

content_en: A project is in the testing phase, and the quality control team informs the project manager that the quality of the deliverables from one vendor is poor. Their investigation found that the staff assigned does not have the required certifications. How did this issue arise?
option_1_content_en: A.The vendors' proposal did not include the list of people assigned to the project.
option_2_content_en: B.The project sponsor did not mandate three references from previous customers.
option_3_content_en: C.The Procurement Management Plan did not include the certifications required
option_4_content_en: D.The quality control team had too high of standards and tested too thoroughly

content_en: A project manager oversees a complex project in which a vendor is responsible for delivering several essential components. The project manager and the vendor team are located in different time zones, and this time zone difference has become a significant challenge, leading to productivity issues within the project. Team members from both sides often struggle to coordinate meetings, share updates, and communicate effectively due to the time zone disparities. What should the project manager do to solve this issue?
option_1_content_en: A.Closely monitor the project schedule and take action if milestones are missed.
option_2_content_en: B.Ask both teams to change their working hours to a common time zone.
option_3_content_en: C.Find a common space and relocate the vendor team with the project team.
option_4_content_en: D.Terminate the engagement and find a new vendor in the local time zone.

content_en: Which leadership style would help people to connect, even when working remotely and never having met each other?
option_1_content_en: A.The participative style
option_2_content_en: B.The Affiliative style
option_3_content_en: C.The Pace Setting style
option_4_content_en: D.The Coaching style

content_en: In your project you need some assistance facilitating meetings, following up on action items, introducing new team members, and mediating conflicts. Who would be the most suitable team member type to assist you with those activities?
option_1_content_en: A.Power Oriented team member.
option_2_content_en: B.Affiliate Oriented team member.
option_3_content_en: C.Achievement Oriented Team member.
option_4_content_en: D.Delivery Oriented Team member.

content_en: A project manager is managing an agile project. In order to make sure there is enough funding available for the project, the project sponsor is asking the project manager for an estimate when the project will be completed. How should the project manager respond to the sponsor?
option_1_content_en: A.Inform the sponsor that an estimate is not necessary, as agile supports responding to change over following a plan.
option_2_content_en: B.Remind the sponsor that agile projects are not judged based on budget and schedule.
option_3_content_en: C.Provide the estimate to the sponsor, as agile supports estimating.
option_4_content_en: D.Influence the sponsor to add a contingency buffer to the cost in case of a cost overrun.

content_en: Engagement and motivation can be successfully achieved by the project manager in a virtual team by all the following, except:
option_1_content_en: A.Goal Setting
option_2_content_en: B.Task Structures
option_3_content_en: C.Inefficient Collaboration
option_4_content_en: D.Reward Systems

content_en: Project managers should wear a leadership face and drive the project team to achieve the expected deliverables. What qualities should a project manager have? (Choose 3).
option_1_content_en: A.Lead
option_2_content_en: B.Ethical
option_3_content_en: C.Adapt
option_4_content_en: D.Aggressive

content_en: A project manager is leading a large business transformation project with the goal of creating a new organizational structure and aligning the IT systems with the new business structure. In which phase of integrated change management should the project manager manage resistance?
option_1_content_en: Phase 1 - Prepare for the change.
option_2_content_en: Phase 2 - Plan the change.
option_3_content_en: Phase 3 - Manage the change.
option_4_content_en: Phase 4 - Reinforce and sustain the change.

content_en: A project manager is on a project in a highly regulated environment with a very formal governance process. The project manager is developing the resource plan and identified that the project needs to engage many vendors. Which strategies should the project manager use to reduce the procurement cycle? (Choose 3).
option_1_content_en: A.Vendors that you used in past projects
option_2_content_en: B.Integrated teams from various departments
option_3_content_en: C.Vendors recommended by management
option_4_content_en: D.Regulated vendor list

content_en: A project being run by a project manager is implementing a new technology. The project manager wants to be sure that the project delivers business value. What roles are critical in ensuring that the organization will benefit from the project delivery? (Choose 3).
option_1_content_en: A.People and culture manager
option_2_content_en: B.Project manager
option_3_content_en: C.Business analyst
option_4_content_en: D.Customer lead

content_en: A project manager is working on a large business transformation project. The project requires a significant change management effort and the project manager has decided to use the Kotter model. The project manager has created a sense of urgency and formed a guiding coalition to implement the change. What else should the project manager do? (Choose 3)
option_1_content_en: A.Develop a vision and strategy.
option_2_content_en: B.Ensure frequent deliveries in short intervals.
option_3_content_en: C.Communicate the vision constantly.
option_4_content_en: D.Ensure business people and developers work together.

content_en: A project manager is leading a project that entails transitioning to agile. The project will pilot the agile delivery modeled around using four resources from a vendor, working alongside two internal resources with no agile experience. The project manager needs to act as a coach for the project team and help them understand the differences between the functioning of a traditional project team and an agile team. What is the most important thing the project manager needs to do to establish agile team behavior?
option_1_content_en: A.Focus on the produced result of the team.
option_2_content_en: B.Build trust within the team.
option_3_content_en: C.Encourage collaboration among the team.
option_4_content_en: D.Hold each team member accountable.

content_en: The headquarters of a multinational company is in Europe, with many regional offices in other countries around the world. The operations director of a regional office decides to establish a project management office (PMO). A project manager has been selected to manage the project, which is in its initial phase. The project manager needs to align stakeholder expectations with the benefits of the project process and the business strategy. Which document should the project manager develop for this purpose?
option_1_content_en: A.Business case
option_2_content_en: B.Benefits management plan
option_3_content_en: C.Project charter
option_4_content_en: D.Project management plan

content_en: A new system is being developed to replace an existing manual process. During a sprint demo, business stakeholders expressed the concern that they would not gain any value from using this system. What should the project manager do next?
option_1_content_en: A.Discuss this with the product manager and identify new user stories to address business concerns.
option_2_content_en: B.Call a steering committee meeting to determine critical success factors for the project.
option_3_content_en: C.Create a project benefits management plan and review it with the stakeholders.
option_4_content_en: D.Review the performance metrics with stakeholders to ensure the system accomplished agreed-upon metrics.

content_en: An agile practitioner has been assigned to lead a software development project in a relatively new industry where the external compliance standards are not clearly defined. What should the agile practitioner do to ensure that the project succeeds?
option_1_content_en: A.Speak to agile managers in other organizations with the same challenges to learn how they address issues.
option_2_content_en: B.Develop a set of standards that work for the role and support the team in implementing them.
option_3_content_en: C.Use global best practices as a guide for project implementation incorporating the new technology trends and monitoring compliance standards.
option_4_content_en: D.Refer to other previous data that exists from related industries.

content_en: An agile project is in its last iteration. During the daily standup, the team realizes that they will not be able to complete all the activities that were planned for the sprint. The team members create a contingency plan. What should the project manager do next?
option_1_content_en: A.Discuss the contingency plan with the product owner.
option_2_content_en: B.Discuss the contingency plan with stakeholders.
option_3_content_en: C.Discuss the contingency plan with the project sponsor.
option_4_content_en: D.Execute the contingency plan immediately.

content_en: A company's leadership team has decided to invest in a new product using an agile approach. The commercial and product teams have started the planning activity for this new venture. Which three key factors does the project manager need in order to deliver this product? (Choose 3)
option_1_content_en: A.Product vision
option_2_content_en: B.Product roadmap
option_3_content_en: C.High-level product backlog
option_4_content_en: D.Key performance indicators (KPIs)

content_en: A senior business stakeholder with many years of experience is pressuring an agile team to deliver most of the promised functionality to the customer 18 months in the future as opposed to multiple, incremental deliveries over the course of the 18 months. What should the project lead do next?
option_1_content_en: A.Work with the agile team to schedule the incremental deliveries to enable delivery of business value sooner to the customer.
option_2_content_en: B.Schedule meetings with the customer to determine their ability to support multiple incremental deliveries.
option_3_content_en: C.Provide details of the concern to the agile team and adjust their goals and release plans to conform to the stakeholder's request.
option_4_content_en: D.Work with the stakeholder to understand what the concerns are while, at the same time, conveying the benefits of incremental deliveries.

content_en: Due to a budget issue, the project team decides to use low-cost equipment with higher testing uncertainty to reduce cost. However, the test results are unstable and are creating discrepancies. One of the team members is aware of the situation and proposes to use high-resolution equipment with lower test uncertainty to increase the testing quality. How should the project manager respond to this proposal?
option_1_content_en: A.Reject the proposal due to budget constraints and follow the quality management plan.
option_2_content_en: B.Accept the proposal because the high-resolution equipment produces precise test results with lower test uncertainty.
option_3_content_en: C.Evaluate the proposal to determine if the high-resolution equipment produces precise test results with lower test uncertainty.
option_4_content_en: D.Accept the proposal because budget is not an issue when quality assurance is taken into consideration.

content_en: The risk register is a document that records details of all identified individual risks to a project. What is the minimal content of this document?
option_1_content_en: A.Identified risks, risk categories, and effects on objectives
option_2_content_en: B.Risks owners, potential risks responses, and risk triggers
option_3_content_en: C.Identified risks, risk owners, and potential risks responses
option_4_content_en: D.Issues log, metrics & trends, and distribution of risks across risk categories

content_en: An aggressive and low-influence stakeholder disrupts a kick-off meeting by complaining about procedural violations in past projects. The project manager's research reveals that the violations had no significant impact. What should the project manager do?
option_1_content_en: A.Apply a withdraw/avoid conflict resolution method.
option_2_content_en: B.Apply a smooth/accommodate conflict resolution method.
option_3_content_en: C.Apply a force/direct conflict resolution method.
option_4_content_en: D.Apply a compromise/reconcile resolution method.

content_en: A project manager is working on the development of a business case to secure funding and resources. What is needed to ensure that the right priority is assigned to the project?
option_1_content_en: A.Developing the most efficient delivery plan
option_2_content_en: B.Developing a clear and detailed project schedule
option_3_content_en: C.Aligning the project with company’s goals and objectives
option_4_content_en: D.Aligning the project with company’s roadmap

content_en: Quality management is a vital aspect of any project. Which of the following quality control aspects is a component of a high functioning measurement system?
option_1_content_en: A.Accuracy
option_2_content_en: B.Non-precision
option_3_content_en: C.Non-repeatability
option_4_content_en: D.Duration

content_en: A project manager is assigned to a project and the first task is to assist in creating the Work Breakdown Structure (WBS). Which tool, technique or document is used as starting point for an effective WBS creation?
option_1_content_en: A.Scope baseline
option_2_content_en: B.Activity list
option_3_content_en: C.Project charter
option_4_content_en: D.WBS dictionary

content_en: The team informed the project leader that they are not sure of the stakeholder needs, despite the multiple collection requirements efforts and engagement in status meetings. How should the project manager approach this issue?
option_1_content_en: A.Require the team to work with the stakeholders to analyze their detailed requirements and sign off on the specification
option_2_content_en: B.Discuss with the team the option of canceling the project since the risk is too great to continue
option_3_content_en: C.Ask the team to write a collection of user stories to capture the needs, prioritize and manage the stories
option_4_content_en: D.Document what the team believes the stakeholders need, show it to stakeholders, and ask for their feedback to share with the team

content_en: A project manager is leading a Scrum team. During Business Acceptance Testing (BAT), the client rejects the deliverable due to poor quality, traced back to a lack of collaboration between team members. What should have the project manager done to prevent this?
option_1_content_en: A.Provided detailed instructions on how and when the work should be done.
option_2_content_en: B.Requested detailed documentation and sign-offs between project phases.
option_3_content_en: C.Implemented detailed tracking of project progress, productivity, and costs.
option_4_content_en: D.Provided a detailed vision and empowered the team making them accountable.

content_en: A project manager is managing a project that has a component using agile. The project sponsor asks the project manager to add a new component to this project which is government regulated with new complex tax-rules with enough time provided to implement these rules. The sponsor suggests implementing this new component using predictive non-agile approach due to its complexity. Which methodology will the project manager use for this new component?
option_1_content_en: A.Inform the project sponsor that you will manage the new component using agile methodology as agile supports one-size-fits-all.
option_2_content_en: B.Use hybrid approach by continuing to manage the existing component using agile, and the new component using predictive.
option_3_content_en: C.Manage the existing component as well as the new component using predictive plan-based approach.
option_4_content_en: D.Seek guidance from project sponsor for which methodology will suit best for new component.

content_en: Good communication etiquettes of a Project Manager include the following when sending emails, except:
option_1_content_en: A.Always responding immediately to emotional messages
option_2_content_en: B.Knowing your audience
option_3_content_en: C.Always being courteous
option_4_content_en: D.Using proper grammar, spelling, and punctuation
